images.name: decide
images.title: How to decide, *duty by duty*
steps: List every duty on one page
The job you're filling, as it's done today, including the things nobody wrote down.
Is there a process you could write down? Does it repeat? Does it arrive outside office hours? Does the other person need a human?
Written process, repeats, all hours: AI Employee. No process, judgment: a person. High volume on a process you'd rather not own: a firm.
Price the options against the page
First-year cost at your real volume, hours of coverage a week, and your team's hours a month, for each.
Before signing with anyone: when this ends, what stays with us? Rules, logs, recordings, the phone number.
